lvis.note: LVIS v1 val spans COCO val2017 AND COCO train2017; no file_name field — names derived from coco_url, train images pulled per-image from images.cocodataset.org.

objects365.reason: v1 requires registration; no public no-auth download URL. v2 yaml exists in ultralytics configs but images are behind OpenDataLab sign-up. Revisit after registration.

open-images.note: v6/v7 validation CSVs on storage.googleapis.com/openimages return 403 without auth; v5 validation CSV is public and its ImageIDs match the CVDF S3 validation bucket.
